verdict.rationale: Proa's docs say each hydrated island emits a small vanilla-JS module plus seed state, served with a shared runtime of about 1.3 KB gzipped. Interactivity code is emitted only for islands that need it, some components ship no JavaScript at all (CSS-only accordion, server-drawn SVG charts), and UI components are vendored into the repo as owned source rather than pulled in as packages. Missing for 10: no explicit statement about third-party client dependencies or supply-chain posture, and no independent or hands-on measurement of real-world bundle sizes.
